notes: Copy only the "mcpServers" block into your client config (for example Claude Desktop). The rest of this file is documentation, not client config.

Replace <YOUR_HOST_HERE> with the public hostname of a deployed instance (no scheme, no path beyond /mcp) and <YOUR_TOKEN_HERE> with the bearer token issued by the server operator. No real secret appears anywhere in this file.
Local development: run the server with ASSISTANT_API_TOKEN set (see "localDevelopment" above) and point your client at http://localhost:8080/mcp with the same Authorization header.

This server is stateless and read-only: every call carries its complete scenario and nothing is saved. Some clients spell the transport type as "http" instead of "streamable-http"; if yours rejects "streamable-http", use "http" with the same URL and headers.
